environment.externalBoundary: Physical hardware, live service accounts, provisioning, distribution, and store operations are owner-only.

pendingQualification: No blocking defect remains in the supported host/Simulator scope. Physical hardware, live accounts, provisioning, distribution, and store operations remain owner-required.

defects.rootCause: The immutable instruction bundle manifest omits 193 extra files; none of its 46 declared files is missing.
defects.disposition: Preserved the original bundle, recorded the validator failure, and independently validated the accepted v3.1 asset package.

defects.rootCause: A first-delivery embedded cipher could make an unconfirmed sender label appear locally trusted.
defects.fix: Treat embedded identity as transient until explicit confirmation; established delivery uses local identity and does not rebind contacts.

defects.rootCause: Message candidate evaluation and persisted cipher inventory did not share one enforceable capacity/work boundary.
defects.fix: Added bounded cipher decoding, a 131072-cipher capacity, a 128 MiB candidate work budget, and one-time envelope unwrapping.

defects.rootCause: App Lock management throttling was not durable across management operations and an extreme persisted counter could overflow.
defects.fix: Unified durable throttling, bounded failed attempts, rejected invalid persisted counts, and used checked saturation.

defects.rootCause: Interrupted Game Center reports could remain stranded in an in-flight state across reload or reactivation.
defects.fix: Recover interrupted reports to pending while preserving attempts and backoff, including same-process reactivation.

defects.rootCause: Remote logical timestamps could advance local state without a bounded relative horizon.
defects.fix: Added a 1048576-step remote advance bound relative to the trusted high-water mark with overflow headroom.

defects.rootCause: Protected files, contact payloads, association journals, and imported fonts needed consistent preallocation bounds.
defects.fix: Added bounded streaming reads, growth sentinels, collection/string limits, and format-specific byte caps.

defects.rootCause: Concurrent pending message and cipher-confirmation state could transiently choose the wrong sheet.
defects.fix: Stage both states before publishing a snapshot and prioritize confirmation import presentation.

defects.rootCause: Eager CKContainer resolution during default runtime composition caused entitlement-free hosted tests to terminate with Signal 5 before deterministic adapters could take control.
defects.fix: Defer CKContainer resolution until the first live CloudKit operation and inject deterministic no-account fixtures into hosted composition paths.

defects.rootCause: The hosted guard runner waited for a child process to exit before draining its output pipes, so verbose output could fill the pipe buffer and deadlock the test.
defects.fix: Capture each guard invocation in bounded temporary files and read the completed output after process termination.

defects.rootCause: The compact iPhone artifact heading kept the FRAME label in a horizontal row at accessibility text sizes, allowing the audit to identify potential clipping.
defects.fix: Use a compact horizontal layout at standard text sizes and stack the heading vertically at accessibility Dynamic Type sizes.
